title: rosa sphaeroidea f. sylvularum
intro: Rosa sphaeroidea f. sylvularum, commonly known as Wild Prairie Rose, is a shrub native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to its potential health benefits such as soothing wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa sphaeroidea f. sylvularum include acting as a vulnerary to promote wound healing, a febrifuge to reduce fever, and a carminative to ease digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
